text:
Sam: T-minus 2h to our change window. quick runway preflight — calling final checks. :airplane:
Priya: Ack. SRE ready, smoke scripts loaded, node drain playbook staged.
Jorge: Release notes posted here: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-22 — please skim the rollback section.
Maya: Product has sign-off on the minor UI changes. No extra experiments in this rollout.
DeployBot: Canary job created: canary-7391 -> v3.4.2 on eu-west-1, 2 pods. Status: warming.
Priya: Canary health check: latency p95 < 220ms, error rate < 0.3% expected for baseline.
Sam: Quick owners: canary watch Priya/Jorge, traffic shift Sam/Priya, rollback owner Jorge.
Oncall: Oncall available for the window. paging policy set to @oncall at threshold 3xx/5xx spike.
Priya: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- sustained error rate > 0.5% over 5m OR
- latency p95 degrade > 40% vs baseline for 5m OR
- user-facing regression confirmed by Product.
Sam: If any of the above, we unpin and roll traffic back to v3.4.1 and open fastrollback ticket.
Jorge: Rollback command (for quick copy):
```
kubectl set image deploy/backend backend=redwood/backend:v3.4.1 --namespace=prod
deploybot rollback canary-7391 --to v3.4.1
```
Priya: Canary ramp schedule here: 0% -> 5% (10m) -> 20% (20m) -> 60% (30m) -> 100% (10m). Stop and hold between ramps for 10m checks.
Maya: Customer-facing notes: we have a short maintenance doc and the page banner ready. Link in release notes.
Sam: Freeze reminders: no infra churn in window besides approved emergency fixes. Docs and release-notes edits locked.
DeployBot: Preflight hooks: smoke-tests: pass, infra-health: pass, config-lint: pass.
Priya: Running smoke now: quick logs attached below:
```
smoke-run --suite basic
OK: datastore, caches, routing
WARN: ephemeral worker warmup 1/3 at t=45s
```
Sam: If warmup fails to reach 3/3 within 6m, we abort and hold. Priya, you will call abort.
Priya: Roger. I'll ping here with any abort or go.
Jorge: I'll be ready to cut release notes to public once we hit 100% and hold 15m stable.
Maya: Product will verify signal set in the 20m hold.
Oncall: I've set alert thresholds: error-rate-5m, latency-p95-10m, tokenization-failures. Pager routing validated.
Sam: Last check: release knobs? (quantization, batching, cache TTL)
Priya: Quantization profile already applied on canary; batching policy set to "conservative" for first 60m. Cache TTL remains 60s.
Sam: Good. I'll start the canary at T-minus 1h 30m. Call "GO" here when you start ramp.
Priya: GO in 5.
DeployBot: Canary ramp started -> 5% traffic.
Sam: Watching dashboards now. tagging @Maya @Jorge for visibility.
